cases.transcript_en: I'm taking a walk in a coffee garden in Kalpetta. I'll show you how coffee and corn grow. Five hundred rupees a person. From nine to twelve in the morning.
I make baskets of bananas in Mananthavady. Tourists will come and make it. Three hundred rupees a basket.
cases.title: Banana Basket Making Tour
cases.description: Tourists can make their own banana baskets in Mananthavady for 300 rupees each.

cases.transcript_en: Kerala will be handed over to my house in Meppadi. Two hundred and fifty rupees per person. 1:00 to 3:00 in the afternoon.
I weave handkerchiefs at Sulthan Bathery. I'll come see the weavers. Two thousand rupees for a sari.
cases.title: Weaving Handkerchiefs at Sulthan Bathery
cases.description: Visit the weavers and see how handkerchiefs are made. Cost: 2000 rupees for a sari.

cases.transcript_en: I'll take the trekking from Meppadi to Mount Chembra. It'll take four hours. Eight hundred rupees a person. It starts at 6:00 in the morning.
cases.title: Trek from Meppadi to Mount Chembra
cases.description: Trekking from Meppadi to Mount Chembra, 4 hours, 800 rupees per person, starts at 6:00 am.

cases.transcript_en: I am teaching Kerala cooking classes in Vythiri. Class is two hours. A thousand rupees a person.
cases.title: Kerala Cooking Classes
cases.description: Learn to cook traditional Kerala dishes in Vythiri. Duration: 2 hours, price: 1000 rupees per person.

cases.transcript_en: I am a beekeeper in Ambalavayal. We'll see tourists come and get the honey.
cases.title: Ambalavayal Beekeeping
cases.description: Come and get honey from our beekeeping in Ambalavayal.

cases.transcript_en: I'll show you my pumpkin garden at Pulpally. An hour's walk. One hundred and fifty rupees a person.
cases.title: Pumpkin Garden Tour
cases.description: An hour's walk from Pulpally, a craft tour where you can learn about and buy handmade pumpkin items.

cases.transcript_en: I make pottery out of clay. You can make yourself a vase. Four hundred rupees a person.
cases.title: Pottery Making
cases.description: Create your own vase using clay. Cost: 400 rupees per person.

cases.transcript_en: We have a homestead in Lakkidi. Two thousand five hundred rupees a night. Including breakfast.
cases.title: Homestead Stay in Lakkidi
cases.description: Experience a rural homestead stay in Lakkidi for 2500 rupees per night, including breakfast.

cases.transcript_en: I'm the guide to Edakkal Cave. Five hundred for adults and two hundred for children.
cases.title: Edakkal Cave Tour
cases.description: Explore the ancient Edakkal Cave with a guide. Adult: 500, Child: 200.

cases.transcript_en: It's raining today. The kids went to school. I'm going to the market in the evening.
Hello, my name is Nur. - Are you all right?
